thread:
Maya: Quick sync re: Atlas  they've asked for a guaranteed pin during a model swap but want an automated rollback bridge if quality drops. Can we define a minimal runbook + ops gates?
Rafi: +1. Proposal: canary at 1% traffic with seeded evals. If quality regresses beyond thresholds -> auto-shift back to pinned model and open SEV.
Jordan: Metrics idea: relative ROUGE delta, median perplexity, and embedding cosine. For embeddings set cosine drop > 0.03 as signal. Need per-family thresholds.
Kei: Ops constraints: failover must complete <30s, need to trace token IDs across routes, and KV cache warm on fallback. Also require a CLI for emergency revert.
Olga: From customer asks: 3-month default pin TTL for legacy deals, with an opt-in to extend. They need comms + an explicit consent flow.
Maya: Draft runbook (short):
- Canary: 1% traffic, seeded prompt set (~500 prompts).
- Eval window: early-check at 4h, default aggregation 48h. Fast-fail if >2 critical regressions in first 4h.
- Thresholds: rouge_delta <= 0.5, p95_latency <= 350ms, embed_cosine >= 0.92
- Action: automatic route flip to pinned model + SEV ticket + route annotation. Manual override window: 60m.
Rafi: Implementation note: add route flag `auto_rollback=true`. Routing hits signaler API which pulls eval stats. We can reuse batching/cache layers; need lightweight signaler service.
Jordan: Need daily baseline generation + seeded repo `catalog/evals/atlas-bridge`. Lucas size ~500 mix customer/synthetic. Harness outputs per-prompt deltas and aggregate signal.
Kei: Timeline: Hosted+Dedic: ~3 sprints. Private needs VPC-bound evals + KMS audit -> +2 sprints. I'll own ops playbook for cache warm.
Olga: I'll lead comms and opt-in UX. Question: customers want a "force pin" to stay pinned despite regressions. Can we log consent?
Rafi: Add tenant-level `force_pin=true` with Console modal that records consent event. We'll show a risk warning.
Maya: Action items:
- Rafi: spike on routing flag + signaler -> PR by Fri
- Jordan: seed prompts + harness -> repo PR next Tue
- Olga: comms + opt-in copy -> draft Mon
- Kei: ops CLI + cache-warm playbook -> draft Tue
Maya: If no objections I'll fold this into the onboarding spec and push a sample rollback policy into catalog templates.
Rafi: No objections.
Jordan: Fine by me, will post seed plan in #eng-ml after PR.
Olga: Adding notes to Atlas ticket and timeline.
Kei: Will draft CLI and playbook snippets.
Maya: Thanks all, will update the spec and ping for async review.
